out_items.name: Proper eating, tasting, drinking, or tobacco use

violations.title: Eating, Drinking, or Using Tobacco
violations.observation: A food employee was observed eating, smoking, or drinking in areas where they may contaminate food, clean equipment, utensils or other items needing protection. A food employee was observed drinking from a coffee cup on the prep/cook line.
violations.corrective_action: Food employees may only eat, drink, or use tobacco in a designated area like a dining room or office area. Employees shall not eat or drink in the kitchen areas, warewashing areas, or storage areas where items may become contaminated. The PIC corrected this during the inspection by discussing this with the employee.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Signage
violations.observation: Observed that sign or poster that notifies food employees to wash their hands is not provided or is not clearly visible at all handwashing sinks used by food employees. There is a new handsink in the prep area which did not have an “employees must wash hands” sign.
violations.corrective_action: Provide a visible sign or poster at all handwashing sinks used by food employees that reminds food employees to wash their hands. The PIC corrected this during the inspection by placing a temporary sign on the sink and will order a permanent sign. All other hand sinks had the required signage.

violations.title: Hot Water Sanitizing Temperature Met
violations.observation: Due to improper operation of the hot water mechanical warewashing machine the thermometer did not reach 160º on the final hot water sanitizing rinse temperature at the left bar dish machine. The unit reached 152º and 157º.
violations.corrective_action: Immediately discontinue use of the dishmachine. Repair the dishmachine so that a thermolabel will turn black. Until the machine is adequately repaired, set up the 3 vat sink to manually wash, rinse and chemically sanitize food-contact surfaces. On the third cycle, the unit reached 160º. Please have the unit serviced to ensure it is working properly. BARTACO (Inspection Date: 07/20/2026) Page 2 of 3

violations.title: Hot Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed hot holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: sauce for duck was 113º in the hot holding unit.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature conrol for safety food shall be held hot at a temperature of 135F or above unless the permit holder is using 'time as the public health control' as specified under 3-501.19. The PIC learned that the sauce had not been fully reheated before being placed in the hot holding unit and had the sauce reheated to 165º for hot holding as required.

violations.title: In-Use Utensils Proper Storage
violations.observation: Dispensing and/or in-use utensils improperly stored between use as follows: several scoops, a knife and other utensils were being stored in standing water that was 100ºF.
violations.corrective_action: During pauses in food preparation or dispensing, food utensils shall be stored in one of the following manners: 1) in the food with their handles above the top of the food and the container, 2) in food that is not time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food with their handles above the top of the food within containers or equipment that can be closed, 3) on a clean portion of the food preparation table or cooking equipment only if the in-use utensil and the food contact surface of the food preparation table or cooking equipment are cleaned and sanitized, 4) in running water of sufficient velocity to flush particulates to the drain, 5) in a clean, protected location if the utensils are used only with a food that is NOT TCS food, or 6) in a container of water if the water is maintained at a temperature of at least 135F and the container is cleaned frequently. The PIC decided to discontinue storing the utensils in standing water and will keep them on the counter and clean and sanitize them every 4 hours.

violations.title: Backflow Prevention, Approved Device Provided
violations.observation: Observed the lack of an approved backflow prevention device on the water supply system. Observed an unapproved splitter installed on the mop sink faucet.
violations.corrective_action: A plumbing system shall be installed to preclude backflow of a solid, liquid, or gas contaminant into the water supply system at each point of use at the food establishment, including on a hose bib if a hose is attached or on a hose bib if a hose is not attached and backflow prevention is required by Law by installing an approved backflow prevention device as specified under 5-202.14. The PIC removed the unapproved splitter during the inspection. If a splitter is needed, please use a Hydro Systems 1951 Pressure Bleed Dual Valve device.

out_items.name: Person in charge present, demonstrates knowledge, and performs duties

violations.title: Permit to Operate Posted in Conspicuous Location
violations.observation: The establishment has not posted the permit to operate in a conspicuous location. The 2025 permit was posted.
violations.corrective_action: A valid permit shall be posted in every food establishment in a conspicuous place in the public view. Food establishment permits are issued for a calendar year and expire on December 31 regardless of the month of issue. Please post the 2026 permit as soon as possible.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Paper Towels Provided
violations.observation: Observed that paper towels were not provided at each handwashing sink. One of the hand sinks in the prep area did not have paper towels available. The dispenser was empty.
violations.corrective_action: Provide paper towels at each hand sink to allow employees to properly dry their hands after handwashing. The manager corrected this immediately by having an employee refill the dispenser. CDI.

violations.title: Cooling from 135F to 41F, No More than 6 Hours
violations.observation: The following cooked time/temperature control for safety food(s) are not being adequately cooled from 135F to 70F within two hours and to 41F within a total of six hours. Observed five 4-inch plastic containers of cooked duck breast that was cooked yesterday were 45°F and not cooled properly. The inserts were nearly full and covered, which did not allow for proper cooling. Caramelized onions cooked today at noon were 95º in the walk-in. Carnitas cooked today and in the walk-in was 86º.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety foods shall be cooled from 135F to 70F within two hours and to 41F within a total of six hours to prevent the growth of harmful bacteria. Foods that have been temperature abused are to be discarded. The EHS discussed proper cooling techniques with the certified food manager to include not overfilling or covering pans while trying to cool foods, and the limited cooling ability of plastic pans. The manager discarded the duck breast. The manager moved the onions and carnitas to an ice bath to cool. CDI.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: raw oysters and raw cod were 43° and 44° in the one door fry station refrigerator.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. The products were in the unit for less than 4 hours and were placed in the walk-in to cool to 41º. CDI.

violations.title: Cooling from 135F to 41F, No More than 6 Hours
violations.observation: The following cooked time/temperature control for safety food(s) are not being adequately cooled from 135F to 70F within two hours and to 41F within a total of six hours. Carnitas observed at 49F in #1. CFM stated carnitas prepared previous evening.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety foods shall be cooled from 135F to 70F within two hours and to 41F within a total of six hours to prevent the growth of harmful bacteria. Foods that have been temperature abused are to be discarded. CFM discarded carnitas. CFM will review proper cooling procedures with staff.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: milk at 43F in #9.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. CFM discarded milk. BARTACO (Inspection Date: 07/29/2025) Page 2 of 3

out_items.name: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage, and display

violations.title: Ice As Coolant Not Used as Food
violations.observation: Observed ice bins at bar with one side being used to store containers of garnish and other side of same bin being used for serving.
violations.corrective_action: After use as a medium for cooling the exterior surfaces of food, packaged foods, beverages, or cooling coils/tubes, the ice may not be used as food. EHS recommended CFM have one ice bin used strictly for serving ice and other ice bin used to keep garnish cold. CFM had employees rearrange ice bins.

out_items.name: Utensils, equipment and linens properly stored, dried and handled

violations.title: Equipment/Utensils, No Cloth Drying
violations.observation: Lids from main hot water water sanitizing dish machine were observed cloth-dried rather than air-dried after cleaning and chemical sanitization.
violations.corrective_action: After cleaning and sanitizing, equipment and utensils may not be cloth dried. CFM discussed with warewashing staff that sanitized items from dish machine must be allowed to air dry.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: Left undercounter hot water sanitizing dish machine observed at maximum temperature of 155F.
violations.corrective_action: Equipment shall be maintained in a state of repair and condition that meets the requirements specified under Parts 4-1 and 4-2. CFM will place work order in for unit. Establishment has two working hot water sanitizing dish machines that can be used.
